definition.description: Converts XML data to JSON format. Parses XML elements, attributes, and text content into a structured JSON object.

inputFields.helpText: The XML string to convert to JSON. Supports elements, attributes, text content, and CDATA sections.
Prefix to use for XML attributes in the JSON output. Default is '@' (e.g., @id, @class).
Property name for text content when an element has both attributes/children and text. Default is '#text'.
Whether to trim leading/trailing whitespace from text content.

outputParameters.description: The parsed JSON object (for direct property access)
The name of the XML root element
True if an error occurred during conversion

connectionTags.description: Triggered when XML was successfully converted to JSON
Triggered when conversion fails (invalid XML or processing error)
